title: Property-test quote arithmetic and configuration boundaries
body:
<!-- liquivault-backlog:quote-properties -->

## Context

Quotes handle selected examples, but there is no generated-input suite that exercises rounding, overflow boundaries and validated rate configurations.

## Scope

`contracts/factoring_escrow/src/lib.rs and src/test.rs`

## Suggested complexity

High; final Wave complexity is set by maintainers in the Drips app.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Generate reproducible inputs across risk tiers, positive face values, durations and valid rate configurations.
- [ ] Assert net_payout + total_discount == face_value and separately floored fee/time arithmetic.
- [ ] Test monotonic discount versus duration/rate, expired maturity, invalid rates and overflow outcomes without panics.
- [ ] Document the seed/reproduction command; keep normal tests deterministic.

## Verification

`cargo test -p factoring_escrow --locked`

title: Expose an explicit restoration planning API
body:

## Context

## Scope
